problem.diagnosis: Candidate generation passes the retrieval gate, but every deterministic five-result selector loses too much of the wider pool. The interface needs more visible documents without silently buying a larger tool-result token budget.

mechanism.name: Evidence Bandwidth Exchange
mechanism.description: Exchange per-document snippet depth for candidate breadth. Retrieve dense top-20, give every result a minimum snippet allocation, then water-fill the remaining per-call snippet budget in rank order. Model parameters, corpus, query calls, and output-token budget remain frozen.

claim_boundary: This calibration measures only serialized search-result payload tokens with a pinned proxy tokenizer on saved development queries. Provider-reported input tokens and cost must still be checked in the live matched comparison.
